column1: # Cops tuxedo diverges from on purpose, one per line: <cop><TAB><reason>.
# lint-baseline.sh marks these rows and prints the reason under the table.
# A mark says the position has been decided, not that the row may be
# ignored: the numbers stay in the table so a climbing count is still seen.

column2: keeps the block delimiters the author wrote; `a b { }` and `a b do end` bind differently, so a rewrite is not layout
breaks an over-long ternary after `?` and `:` rather than rewriting it as if/else, a change of construct
chains indent one level from the statement, not aligned to the receiver (see format-verify.rubocop.yml)
leaves `<<-` alone: its body whitespace is part of the string, so `<<~` is a change of value
